title: Inflationary Kicks and Coulomb Filtering of Spectator Dark Matter
summary: Light spectator fields provide a compelling inflationary origin for scalar dark matter, but their primordial fluctuations often generate excessive isocurvature perturbations on large scales. We develop a novel, exactly solvable filtering mechanism based on a tower of $δ-$function contributions to the spectator mass, which we call kicks, whose dense limit converges to a smooth Coulomb-like profile.
